title: Summit Retro Credit Route Mileage Schedule
content:
The Crestline Summit Loyalty Program adds route miles to a retro credit according to the itinerary class of the credited ticket, as the ticket's record under the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter shows it.

| Itinerary class of the credited ticket | Miles added to the retro credit |
|---|---|
| Long-haul international | 1500 |
| Short-haul international | 500 |
| Domestic | None |

**Schedule notes**

1. The addition is a flat number of miles. It does not depend on the fare, the base miles or the member's tier.
2. The itinerary class is that of the ticket whose flown coupon the retro credit credits.
3. A domestic ticket carries no route miles on its retro credit.

**Hypothetical reading.** Two retro credits of 2000 base miles each, one on a long-haul international ticket and one on a short-haul international ticket, receive 1500 and 500 route miles respectively; a domestic ticket of the same fare receives none.
